key_insight: QUARTZ automates retinal vessel measurement across diverse image datasets to support biomarker research; this paper does not study cancer drug discovery.
clinical_relevance: Retinal vessel morphology may inform research into ocular and systemic diseases, but clinical benefit is not established here.
method: Uses AI-enabled retinal vasculometry to measure vessel topology and size.
Leverages 26 annotated datasets to improve cross-dataset generalisation.
Extracts useful information from lower-quality, partially illuminated images.
evidence_signal: External EPIC-Norfolk evaluation reported F1 scores of 0.8305 for arterioles, 0.8477 for venules, 0.8741 for vessels, 0.9532 for optic discs, 0.8677 for optic cups, and 0.9197 for image quality classification.
watch_item: Cross-dataset improvements were not observed for optic cup segmentation or image quality classification, so gains should not be assumed across all tasks.
paper_title: QUARTZ: Cross-Dataset Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Retinal Vasculometry
